name: Overgrow
description: Powers up Grass-type moves when HP is low.

name: Blaze
description: Powers up Fire-type moves when HP is low.

name: Torrent
description: Powers up Water-type moves when HP is low.

name: Static
description: May paralyze an opponent that makes contact.

name: Run Away
description: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

name: Flash Fire
description: Powers up Fire-type moves hit by fire.

name: Water Absorb
description: Restores HP when hit by Water-type moves.

name: Volt Absorb
description: Restores HP when hit by Electric-type moves.

name: Levitate
description: Gives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

name: Inner Focus
description: The Pokémon's intensely focused mind prevents it from flinching.

name: Quick Feet
description: Boosts Speed when the Pokémon has a status condition.

name: Intimidate
description: Lowers the foe's Attack upon entering battle.

name: Pale Flame
description: An unnaturally cold flame engulfs the Pokémon; Fire-type moves grow stronger, and contact may freeze.

name: Cursed Body
description: Contact with the Pokémon may disable the attacker's move.

name: Snow Cloak
description: Raises evasion in a hailstorm.

name: Pressure
description: The foe's moves cost double PP due to intimidation.

name: Super Luck
description: Boosts the critical-hit ratio of moves.

name: Ice Body
description: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in a hailstorm.

name: Drought
description: The Pokémon's presence harshly brightens the battlefield.

name: Unstable
description: A Team Krampus experiment trait: has a chance to gain a temporary stat boost when damaged.
